text: {"purpose":"Processes a daily transaction file, validates each record against cross‑reference and account data, updates account and transaction balance files, writes accepted transactions to a transaction file and rejected ones to a reject file.","inputs":["DALYTRAN-FILE","XREF-FILE","ACCOUNT-FILE","TCATBAL-FILE"],"outputs":["TRANSACT-FILE","DALYREJS-FILE"],"side_effects":["Updates account master file balances","Updates transaction category balance file records"],"role":"batch","error_handling":"Checks APPL-RESULT after each file operation; on error displays message, writes status, and calls CEE3ABD to abort.","evidence":[{"line_start":202,"line_end":219,"claim":"Main processing loop reads daily transactions and routes to validation or reject."},{"line_start":345,"line_end":369,"claim":"Reads next record from DALYTRAN-FILE and sets EOF flag."},{"line_start":1500,"line_end":1700,"claim":"Performs validation by looking up cross‑reference and account, setting failure reason."},{"line_start":2000,"line_end":2440,"claim":"Posts transaction, updates TCATBAL and account records, writes to TRANSACT-FILE."},{"line_start":2700,"line_end":3000,"claim":"Updates transaction category balance and account balances, writes transaction record."}]}
